settings.up: +Y (glTF; Blender (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y)); glTF x = lot x, z = lot y (CityIsoCamera.lot_to_world)

materials.lm_toon: toon: 3-band ramp x vertex colour (tone baked); alpha = part value 0.55-1.0 -> ROUGHNESS (ink material edges)
materials.lm_toon_lines: lm_toon, darkened toward (8, 6, 12)/255 by 0.55 x reveal q (REBEL_CELL detail-line buildings)
materials.lm_lit: lm_toon + emission 0.25 x colour (floodlit towers; LandmarkLook.lit_emission)
materials.lm_neon: emissive: vertex colour x neon gain (night 1.0, day 0.75)
materials.lm_win: emissive windows: vertex colour x window gain (day: 0.55, mixed 0.55 toward dark glass); alpha = the window's seeded value
materials.lm_win_ring: lm_win, visible while alpha > reveal q (+/- 0.12 flicker band at the front): the blackout ring
materials.lm_win_lines: lm_win, visible while alpha < (1 - q) x 0.85: lit detail lines before the reveal
materials.lm_win_fist_home: red fist windows, home look (70 % density baked) x LandmarkLook.fist_gain
materials.lm_win_fist_dispatch: red fist windows, DISPATCH look (90 %, glitch rows, a few white); show instead of _home
materials.lm_beam: translucent light cone: vertex colour at 0.22 over what is behind, no depth write (no ink)
